project.name: Music Wizard :: Integration Tests
project.description:
Tests that span modules. Mostly the slow, externally-dependent ones -- model downloads, LilyPond invocation, the MIDI to audio to Score ground-truth loop -- which are named *IT and only run under -Pintegration.
Two are neither slow nor externally dependent and are named *Test, so surefire runs them in the default build. MidiRoundTripTest exports a Score through mw-notation and reads it back through mw-transcribe, which needs no audio, no model and no binary; it is here because neither of those modules may depend on the other -- mw-transcribe pulls in mw-ml, which the notation layer is not allowed to see -- and this is the module that already depends on both. LilyPondComplaintsTest reads LilyPond's diagnostics without running it, and explains there why it belongs here.
`mvn verify` stays fast, offline and binary-free either way.
